description: Adsorption Energy of OH on IrO2(110) Surface (rutile P4_2/mnm, spin-polarized, CHE/water reference, Ir 5d +U optional/small)
user_prompt: Calculate the adsorption energy of OH on the IrO2(110) rutile surface (P4_2/mnm) at the coordinatively unsaturated Ir site. Report the final adsorption energy Eads (in eV), defined as Eads = E(slab+OH) - E(slab) - (E_H2O - 1/2 E_H2).

references: Man, Su, Calle-Vallejo, Hansen, Martinez, Inoglu, Kitchin, Jaramillo, Norskov & Rossmeisl, ChemCatChem 3, 1159 (2011)
Ping, Galli & Goddard, J. Phys. Chem. C 119, 11570 (2015)
method.modeling: Rutile IrO2(110) slab with at least 4 layers, vacuum >= 15 Angstrom, and a 1x2 or larger surface cell; adsorb OH on a coordinatively-unsaturated Ir site. Reference Eads to the clean slab plus E_H2O - 1/2 E_H2, not to a gas-phase OH radical.
method.rationale: Value follows Man et al.'s low-coverage electronic DE_HO* for IrO2(110) in the CHE water/H2 reference convention. The target state is OH on a CUS Ir site; using a free OH radical reference gives a different quantity. The +/-0.20 eV absolute tolerance covers low/high coverage spread, RPBE/PBE differences, small Ir 5d +U choices, and OH orientation.
